# MCP gateway endpoint

<!-- Generated by `go run docs/roadmap/gen.go docs` from tickets.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Phase:** [P4 · Agents everywhere](../README.md#phase-4--agents-everywhere) · **Lane:** Worker · **Label:** `feature:mcp-gateway` · **Epic:** [#191](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/191) · **Tickets:** 8 (2S 6M)

Workers expose MCP gateways at `/mcp/{gateway}` over Streamable HTTP. Each gateway bundles several upstream MCP servers from the registry, presents one namespaced tool list, routes calls to the right upstream, and applies the existing verdict engine and per-user credentials, so agents get one MCP URL instead of many.

## How we build it

- New package internal/mcp/hub (the existing internal/mcp/gateway stays the verdict engine). Served on a dedicated worker listener `mcpGateway.listen` (default off, e.g. :8090, optional TLS) because agents call it directly, not through CONNECT.
- Auth: `Authorization: Bearer <warden session token>` verified like proxy identity; agent from `act.sub` (or port mapping when identity is off); session id `Mcp-Session-Id` (128-bit random), idle TTL 30m, max 1024 sessions per worker; DELETE ends a session.
- Gateway definitions in the CP and bundle: `gateways: [{name, servers: [{registryId, tools: [...]}]}]`; effective tools = gateway selection ∩ registry approvedTools ∩ policy.
- tools/list fans out to upstreams in parallel (per-upstream timeout 5s), names tools `server__tool`, drops tools that fail pins; tools/call splits the prefix, runs `OnRequestCtx` with session key `agent:gateway:server`, forwards, then `OnResponse` on the result. Only tools are proxied in v1; resources/prompts return method not found.
- Upstream HTTP/SSE traffic loops back through the worker's own forward proxy so allowlist, DLP, secret swap, per-user placeholders and audit apply unchanged; stdio upstreams are launched after `stdio.VerifyBinary`/`VerifyEd25519` with registry integrity.
- Per-user upstream sessions keyed by (sub, server) when the server needs per-user credentials; missing grant -> Phase 3 JIT tool error or park.

## Done when

An agent configured with one gateway URL lists namespaced tools from an HTTP and a stdio upstream, calls them with per-user credentials, and denied tools are blocked by the same verdict engine as proxied MCP traffic.

### 1/8 · W-P4-MGW-01

**Spike: Streamable HTTP server and Go MCP SDK choice**

Type **spike** · Size **S** · Issue [#192](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/192)

Evaluate the official modelcontextprotocol/go-sdk against a hand-rolled JSON-RPC layer for server side (Streamable HTTP, session ids, SSE responses) and client side (HTTP, legacy SSE, stdio). Check license, dependency weight and whether raw JSON bodies stay accessible for the verdict engine. Output a short ADR in docs/adr.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] ADR names the chosen approach and spec version
- [ ] Prototype handles initialize + tools/list against one upstream
- [ ] Raw message access for OnRequest/OnResponse confirmed

**Unblocks:** [`W-P4-MGW-03`](mcp-gateway.md#38--w-p4-mgw-03) Serve Streamable HTTP /mcp/{gateway} with sessions

### 3/8 · W-P4-MGW-03

**Serve Streamable HTTP /mcp/{gateway} with sessions**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#194](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/194)

Create internal/mcp/hub with an `http.Handler` for POST/GET/DELETE on `/mcp/{gateway}` and a session manager (Mcp-Session-Id, idle TTL 30m, cap 1024, LRU eviction). Verify the Bearer token with the Phase 1/2 verifier and bind the session to (sub, agent); a request with a session id from another identity gets 404. Start the listener from internal/worker when `mcpGateway.listen` is set.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] initialize returns a session id and tools capability
- [ ] Session reused with another user's token is rejected
- [ ] Unknown gateway name returns 404

### 4/8 · W-P4-MGW-04

**Add HTTP and SSE upstream connectors via loopback proxy**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#195](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/195)

Implement `Upstream` interface (Initialize, ListTools, CallTool, Close) in internal/mcp/hub for Streamable HTTP and legacy SSE servers. Their HTTP client uses the worker's own proxy listener as HTTP proxy so allowlist, DLP, secret swap and audit apply; SSE parsing reuses internal/mcp/sse `Scan`. Per-upstream timeouts and reconnect with backoff.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Upstream request appears in worker analytics as normal egress
- [ ] Upstream not on allowlist fails with a tool error
- [ ] SSE upstream results are parsed and returned

### 5/8 · W-P4-MGW-05

**Add stdio upstream connector with integrity checks**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#196](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/196)

Implement the stdio `Upstream`: verify the binary with `stdio.VerifyBinary`/`VerifyEd25519` using registry integrity before exec, run with a minimal env (placeholders resolved from the secret backend), newline JSON-RPC framing, restart on crash with backoff, kill on worker shutdown. Its own outbound network still goes through the worker proxy via HTTPS_PROXY.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Mismatched binary hash refuses to start
- [ ] Crashed process restarts and in-flight calls get a tool error
- [ ] Child gets HTTPS_PROXY pointing at the worker

**Depends on:** [`W-P4-MGW-03`](mcp-gateway.md#38--w-p4-mgw-03) Serve Streamable HTTP /mcp/{gateway} with sessions

### 6/8 · W-P4-MGW-06

**Aggregate tools/list and route tools/call with verdicts**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#197](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/197)

Fan out tools/list to the gateway's upstreams in parallel, namespace as `server__tool`, filter to effective tools, and feed results through the verdict engine's OnResponse so inventory, poisoning and pin checks run. For tools/call, split the prefix, run `OnRequestCtx` (session key `agent:gateway:server`), rewrite the name, forward, then `OnResponse`; Deny maps to a JSON-RPC error like `stdio.blockError`. One slow upstream does not fail the whole list.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Tools from two upstreams appear namespaced
- [ ] Denied tool returns an error without contacting the upstream
- [ ] Upstream timeout drops only that server's tools and records a finding

**Depends on:** [`W-P4-MGW-04`](mcp-gateway.md#48--w-p4-mgw-04) Add HTTP and SSE upstream connectors via loopback proxy; [`W-P4-DGR-05`](delegation-grants.md#59--w-p4-dgr-05) Enforce grant tool set in worker MCP verdicts

**Unblocks:** [`W-P4-PARK-05`](park-notify.md#56--w-p4-park-05) Park MCP tool calls with progress notifications; [`W-P4-MGW-07`](mcp-gateway.md#78--w-p4-mgw-07) Use per-user credentials for gateway upstreams

### 7/8 · W-P4-MGW-07

**Use per-user credentials for gateway upstreams**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#198](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/198)

When a registry server is marked per-user (`provider`), keep upstream sessions keyed by (sub, server) and resolve credentials through the Phase 3 per-user secret path. If the user has no connection, return the Phase 3 JIT tool error result (or park when enabled). Upstream sessions close when the gateway session ends or idles out.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Two users get separate upstream sessions
- [ ] Missing connection returns authorization_required with authorize_url
- [ ] No user token is logged

**Depends on:** [`W-P4-MGW-06`](mcp-gateway.md#68--w-p4-mgw-06) Aggregate tools/list and route tools/call with verdicts
